question.problem: Which of the following points lies  in the fourth quadrant?
question.worked_solution:
- The point $(2,-2)$ is below and to the right of the origin, so it is in the fourth quadrant $✓$

- The point $(1,1)$ is above and to the right of the origin, so it is in the first quadrant $\times $

- The point $(2,3)$ is above and to the right of the origin, so it is in the first quadrant $\times $

- The point $(-1,-1)$ is below and to the left of the origin, so it is in the third quadrant $\times $

- The point $(-2,2)$ is above and to the left of the origin, so it is in the second quadrant $\times $
